description: Implementation of the Buffer9 class for Direct3D 9 rendering in ANGLE, managing buffer data and operations.

classes.name: Buffer9
classes.description: A class representing a Direct3D 9 buffer with methods for data management and interaction with the rendering context.

methods.name: Buffer9
methods.description: Constructor initializing Buffer9 with buffer state and renderer.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: supportsDirectBinding
methods.description: Indicates whether direct binding is supported (returns false).

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets buffer data, resizing memory if necessary, and updates usage.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data at a specified offset.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies data from another buffer into this buffer.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Unreachable in D3D9, indicates mapping is unsupported.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Unreachable in D3D9, indicates range mapping is unsupported.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unreachable in D3D9, indicates unmapping is unsupported.

methods.name: markTransformFeedbackUsage
methods.description: Unreachable in D3D9, related to transform feedback usage.
